Postgres: Fetch Role-Specific Reference & Learned Rules

parameters.query:
SELECT
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT row_to_json(r1) FROM (
       SELECT role_category, sample_summary_html, sample_skills_html, sample_experience_html, include_maerke_stratcomm, include_marketing_projects
       FROM role_few_shot_library
       WHERE LOWER(role_category) = LOWER('{{ $json.roleCategory }}') AND is_active = TRUE
       ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ) r1),
    (SELECT row_to_json(r2) FROM (
       SELECT role_category, sample_summary_html, sample_skills_html, sample_experience_html, include_maerke_stratcomm, include_marketing_projects
       FROM role_few_shot_library
       WHERE LOWER(role_category) = LOWER('{{ $json.closestBaseArchetype }}') AND is_active = TRUE
       ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ) r2)
  ) AS role_reference,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(l)), '[]'::json) FROM (
     SELECT section_name, rule_instruction
     FROM learned_rules
     WHERE is_active = TRUE AND UPPER(COALESCE(role_category, 'ALL')) IN ('ALL', 'GLOBAL', UPPER('{{ $json.roleCategory }}'), UPPER('{{ $json.closestBaseArchetype }}'))
     ORDER BY id ASC
  ) l) AS active_rules;

nodes.name: Postgres: INSERT Cached Sections & Drive ID (No Upsert)

parameters.query:
DELETE FROM resume_generations
WHERE resume_id = '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.resumeId }}'
   OR (s_no = '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.sNo }}' AND '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.sNo }}' <> '')
   OR (LOWER(TRIM(company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM($1)) AND LOWER(TRIM(position_title)) = LOWER(TRIM($2)));

INSERT INTO resume_generations (
  resume_id, s_no, job_id, company_name, position_title, role_category,
  extracted_jd_keywords, summary_html, skills_html, experience_html,
  marketing_projects_html, certifications_html, education_html, hobbies_html,
  drive_file_id, drive_web_link, resume_status
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.resumeId }}',
  '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.sNo }}',
  '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.jobId }}',
  $1, $2,
  '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.roleCategory }}',
  $3::jsonb,
  $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10,
  '{{ $json.id }}',
  '{{ $json.webViewLink }}',
  'Generated'
);
